panel.title: Your home, organised together.
panel.text: Plan the week's meals, share one shopping list and keep shared and private expenses apart, with the people you live with.

signUp.title: Create your account
signUp.lede: Next, we'll set up your household together.
signUp.confirmNote: We'll send you an email to confirm it's really you.
signUp.failed: We couldn't create your account. Try again in a moment.

checkInbox.title: Check your inbox
checkInbox.sent: We sent a link to {email}. Open it to confirm your email and set up your household.
checkInbox.note: The link works for 1 hour. Can't find the email? Look in your spam or promotions folder.
checkInbox.resent: We sent a new link. The previous one no longer works.
checkInbox.wait: You can ask for another link in {seconds} s.
checkInbox.failed: We couldn't send the email. Try again in a few minutes.

forgotPassword.title: Reset your password
forgotPassword.lede: Enter the email you signed up with and we'll send you a link to choose a new password.
forgotPassword.sent: If an account exists for {email}, we sent it a link to choose a new password.
forgotPassword.note: The link works for 1 hour. Can't find the email? Look in your spam or promotions folder.
forgotPassword.linkExpired: That link has expired or was already used. Ask for a new one below.

resetPassword.title: Choose a new password
resetPassword.lede: You'll be signed in with it, and signed out on your other devices.
resetPassword.expired: Reset links work once and for 1 hour. Ask for a new one and use the latest email.

signIn.title: Sign in
signIn.lede: Meals, shopping and money, shared with the people you live with.
signIn.unverified: Confirm your email first. We sent a link to {email}.

errors.emailNotConfirmed: Confirm your email first. Open the link we sent you, or ask for a new one.
errors.linkExpired: That link has expired or was already used. Sign in to get a new one.
errors.rateLimited: Too many attempts. Wait a few minutes and try again.
errors.weakPassword: Choose a longer password, one that is harder to guess.
errors.generic: Something went wrong. Try again in a moment.

validation.invalidEmail: Enter an email address like name@example.com.
validation.passwordTooLong: This password is too long. Use 72 characters or fewer.

comingSoon.text: {section} isn't ready yet. Everything else in HØEM works as usual.

new.title: New household
new.lede: The type decides who can see private expenses and how costs are shared. You can change it later.
new.name: Household name
new.minorCreator: People under 14 join a household through a parent, who adds them to a family.

settings.title: Household settings
settings.name: Name
settings.typeHelp: Changing the type never reveals existing private data.
settings.typeSaved: {type, select, single {{name} is now just for you.} family {{name} is now a family household.} shared_flat {{name} is now a shared flat.} other {{name} now follows its own rules.}}

typeChange.title: Change to {type}?
typeChange.lede: The new rules only apply to things created from now on. Everything already saved keeps who can see it.

family: Parents will see the private expenses children add from now on.
The family shares one meal plan.
Only parents invite people and set roles.
shared_flat: Private expenses are seen only by whoever adds them.
Everyone can keep private shopping lists and meal plans.
Owners invite people and set roles.
other: It starts with the shared-flat rules; you can adjust them later.
Private expenses are seen only by whoever adds them.

typeChange.rolesTitle: Who is who in the family?
typeChange.rolesLede: Parents manage the family and see children's private expenses from now on.
typeChange.otherMembers: {name} has {count, plural, one {# other member} other {# other members}}. Remove them first, then change the type.
typeChange.minorTitle: This household must stay a family
typeChange.minor: Someone in it is under 14, and children under 14 can only belong to a family household.
